description: Create a saved formula measure in Sisense metadata.

measure.description: Measure object in Sisense metadata format.

examples.user_query: Add a measure 'total_sales' on the 'sales_data' table of the 'sales_db' datasource that sums the sales_amount column.
examples.notes: This call creates a measure that calculates the total sales by summing the 'sales_amount' column in the 'sales_data' table.

examples.user_query: Create a measure to calculate average order value for the 'orders' table.
examples.notes: This call adds a measure to calculate the average order value using the 'order_total' column in the 'orders' table.

examples.user_query: Define a measure to count the number of customers in the 'customer_data' table.
examples.notes: This call creates a measure to count the total number of customers based on the 'customer_id' column in the 'customer_data' table.

description: Retrieve saved filter dimensions for a datasource.

examples.user_query: List the saved dimensions for the 'SalesData' datasource.
examples.notes: This call retrieves the saved filter dimensions for the 'SalesData' datasource. Use this when you need to understand the available dimensions for filtering or analysis.

examples.user_query: I need the dimensions for the datasource hosted at 'localhost/FinanceModel'.
examples.notes: This call fetches dimensions for the datasource identified by its full name 'localhost/FinanceModel'. Use this when the full name is required to uniquely identify the datasource.

examples.user_query: Can you provide dimensions for the 'MarketingAnalytics' datasource hosted at 'localhost/MarketingModel'?
examples.notes: This call retrieves dimensions for the 'MarketingAnalytics' datasource while also specifying its full name 'localhost/MarketingModel'. Use this when both identifiers are available and needed for clarity.

description: Retrieve saved formula measures for a datasource.

examples.user_query: List the saved measures for the 'Sales' datasource.
examples.notes: This call retrieves all saved formula measures for the 'Sales' datasource using its identifier.

examples.user_query: Can you show me the measures for the datasource hosted at localhost/MyModel?
examples.notes: This call fetches measures for the datasource using its full name 'localhost/MyModel'.

examples.user_query: I need to check the measures for the Marketing datasource hosted at localhost/MarketingModel.
examples.notes: This call retrieves measures for the 'Marketing' datasource using both its identifier and full name.

description: Retrieve all datasources visible to the authenticated user.

examples.user_query: List the datasources I can access in my Sisense environment.
examples.notes: This call retrieves a list of all datasources visible to the authenticated user. Use it to get an overview of available data connections.

examples.user_query: Show me all the datasources I can use to build dashboards.
examples.notes: This call is useful for identifying datasources you have permission to access, which can then be used for creating or updating dashboards.

examples.user_query: List all available datasources for my account.
examples.notes: This call provides a complete list of datasources accessible to the current user, helping to ensure you are aware of all available data connections.
